Name the games you play with your friends. It’s Time to Play 2.1 For the Teacher : • Take the children to an open space to sing this poem. UNIT TWO Let’s go round and round with our friends around Let’s go round and round with our friends around And sit down. Let’s go up, up, up down, down, down Let’s go up, up, up down, down, down And touch the ground.
